The whole study proceeds in small fixed experiments, with about 30 minutes of computer work as a per-experiment target. The first proposed chunk uses five random paragraphs plus two saved failure cases; this already-exposed petition is an explanatory walkthrough, not an added sample or another model request. Costs and uncertainty accumulate across chunks.
